subject: general
question: Which of the following is a compound?
solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Salt (NaCl)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **compound** is a substance formed when two or more **chemical elements** are **chemically bonded** together in a **fixed ratio** by mass.
 
• **Salt (NaCl)**, also known as **Sodium Chloride**, is a classic example of a compound. It is formed by the **ionic bonding** of **Sodium (Na)** and **Chlorine (Cl)**. ***Hence, option 1 is correct.***
 
• In a compound, the properties of the resulting substance are entirely different from its constituent elements. For instance, **Sodium** is a highly reactive metal and **Chlorine** is a toxic gas, but their compound, **Salt**, is a stable, edible crystalline solid used in **food preservation** and seasoning.
 
• The constituents of a compound cannot be separated by physical methods such as **filtration**, **decantation**, or **centrifugation**. They can only be separated into their elements by **chemical** or **electrochemical reactions** like **electrolysis**.
 
• Compounds always follow the **Law of Constant Proportions**, meaning every sample of **NaCl** will always contain **Sodium** and **Chlorine** in the same **1:1 ratio** of atoms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Soil:**
 
 
• **Soil** is a **heterogeneous mixture**. It consists of varying amounts of **minerals**, **organic matter (humus)**, **gases**, **liquids**, and countless **organisms**.
 
• Because its composition is not uniform and the components are not chemically bonded in a fixed ratio, it does not qualify as a compound. ***Hence, option 2 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Lemon Juice:**
 
 
• **Lemon juice** is a **mixture** (specifically a **solution**) containing **water (H2O)**, **citric acid**, **Vitamin C**, and **sugars**.
 
• The ingredients in lemon juice retain their individual chemical identities and can vary in **concentration** depending on the fruit. ***Hence, option 3 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Air:**
 
 
• **Air** is a **homogeneous mixture** of several gases. It primarily consists of **Nitrogen (78%)**, **Oxygen (21%)**, **Argon (0.9%)**, and **Carbon Dioxide (0.04%)**.
 
• Since these gases are physically mixed and not chemically combined, and their proportions can vary slightly based on **location** or **altitude**, air is classified as a mixture rather than a compound. ***Hence, option 4 is incorrect.***
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Characteristics of Compounds:**
 
 
• A compound has a **fixed melting point** and **boiling point**.
 
• The formation of a compound usually involves the **absorption** or **release of energy** in the form of **heat** or **light**.
 
 
 
• **Difference between Mixtures and Compounds:**
 
 
• **Mixtures** can be separated by **physical means** (like using a magnet to separate iron filings from sulfur), whereas **compounds** (like **Iron Sulfide**) cannot.
 
• Common examples of other compounds include **Water (H2O)**, **Carbon Dioxide (CO2)**, and **Methane (CH4)**.
